slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the demand points: must the demand at each demand point j be met exactly (i.e., total quantity received at demand point j equals b_j), or is it allowed to receive less than b_j (demand not fully satisfied)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each demand point must receive exactly b_j or may receive less, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, defined as the sum of all unit transportation costs (production-to-station plus station-to-demand) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included both transportation and fixed station costs, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; remaining clarifications concerned P2 or modeling details.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots—exact demand satisfaction and total-cost minimization—before stopping, with no silent assumptions on those slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
